description: This file defines the class AttributeData, which encapsulates data pertaining to device attributes including identifiers, types, success status, data content, and manufacturer ID. It provides constructors for different initialization scenarios, as well as getter methods for accessing these properties.

classes.name: AttributeData
classes.description: A data class representing an attribute with ID, type, success status, data length, data content (Base64 encoded), and optional manufacturer ID.

methods.name: AttributeData(int, int, byte[])
methods.description: Constructor initializing AttributeData with ID, type, and raw byte data, encoding data to Base64 and calculating data length.

methods.name: AttributeData(int, int, String)
methods.description: Constructor initializing AttributeData with ID, type, and Base64 data string, setting success to true.

methods.name: AttributeData(int, int, byte[], Integer)
methods.description: Constructor initializing AttributeData with ID, type, raw data, and manufacturer ID, encoding data to Base64.

methods.name: AttributeData(int, int, String, Integer)
methods.description: Constructor initializing AttributeData with ID, type, Base64 data string, and manufacturer ID, setting success to true.

methods.name: getMfgId()
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer ID if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: isSuccess()
methods.description: Returns whether the data retrieval was successful.

methods.name: getDataLen()
methods.description: Returns the length of the data in bytes, decoding Base64 data if necessary.

methods.name: getRawData()
methods.description: Decodes and returns the raw byte array of the data.
